name: icmSendAtt
label: Send Attitude (127257)
description: send NMEA2000 Attitude (roll/pitch) from the ICM-20948 IMU. Turn off while calibrating if you don't want uncalibrated values on the bus.

name: icmRollOff
label: Roll calibration offset
description: degrees added to the raw roll (heel) reading to correct for IMU mounting orientation. With the boat confirmed level, press the "C" button - it live-previews the negative of the current raw roll (i.e. the offset that would zero it out); type that number into the box and press Set.

name: icmPitchOff
label: Pitch calibration offset
description: degrees added to the raw pitch (trim) reading to correct for IMU mounting orientation - same "C" button procedure as the roll offset.
